'''Decipher Games Radio''' ('''DGR''') was Decipher's last regular audio show, four episodes from 4 March to 15 April 2005. It followed [[WARS Radio|Decipher WARS Radio]] and returned to a general format covering all of Decipher's games, in the manner of [[Radio Free Decipher]]. [[Mark Tuttle]] continued as host.<ref name="lotrpc-rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher], LOTR-TCG Player's Council wiki (sections "Decipher WARS Radio" and "Decipher Games Radio": dates, lengths, episode descriptions, missing files).</ref>

Episodes 1 and 2 are not among the recovered files; only a description of episode 2 survives.<ref name="lotrpc-rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher], LOTR-TCG Player's Council wiki (sections "Decipher WARS Radio" and "Decipher Games Radio": dates, lengths, episode descriptions, missing files).</ref>
